title: manni content-strategy strict overlay v1.0.0
description: The strict overlay for manni:content-strategy:1.0.0. Stack it beside the open vocabulary. It narrows the form of values the open vocabulary already claims and requires no key.

audience.description: Strict holds the audience id to kebab case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

persona.description: Strict holds the persona id to kebab case: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
